## Purpose
The live state of API requests in flight and what each is doing, behind the activity bar and tray. It is filled by `lib/ops/tracker` and never persisted.

## Responsibilities
- **Types:**
  - `OpStatus`: pending, completed, failed;
  - `OpStep`: id, kind (stage, tool, step or model), name, state, ms, error;
  - `OpLayer`: name, label, state (pending, active, completed, skipped, failed), ms;
  - `Bytes`.
- **`TrackedOp`:**
  - id, method, url;
  - label (what the user did, in words);
  - background (a read);
  - startedAt, finishedAt, status, error;
  - upload and download progress;
  - stage, measured (the last counted stage), steps, layers, note;
  - live (the progress stream is open).
- **`useOpsStore`:** `ops` keyed by id, with `add`, `patch(id, fn)` and `remove`.

## Key elements
`useOpsStore`, `TrackedOp`.

## Control flow
None.

## Data, state and side effects
In memory only.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Filled by:** `lib/ops/tracker`.
- **Read by:** the activity components (`components/activity`).

## Error handling and edge cases
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
A reload ends every request anyway, so nothing here is persisted.

## How to rebuild this file
A plain zustand store with these types.
